messages.content_text: I need to be more patient  in the market. I need to start only executing on the 5 min time frame for a better win rate, and only taking high probability setups. Instead, I need to mark my levels and set alerts, then hop back on when the levels get tapped and wait for a 5 min entry trigger.

messages.content_text:
First i marked out pdh then went down to the 4hr then i started looking for a mmxm or what i think is a mmxm im still learning it i looked for liquidity i saw some sellside resting into a fvg it wasn’t really close to price so i looked for more.

Then i looked above saw a fvg and i saw on the 4 hour and one below with some engineered liquidity marked those out and reh swept on the 4 hour so i went to the 1 hr to see it in more detail 

So on the one hour i see the low inside the fvg that swept the REL the highs that swept the REH and liquidity inside the 4hr fvg then i went to the 15min

Then at 9:30 it swept all the lows dipping inside the fvg and went higher

So i went to the five minute and seen a cisd above 00:00 ko and put my entry at the cisd and a 10 point stop with 40 points for a 4rr and it went to tp after tapping 00:00 ko

messages.author: Ferrone
messages.content_text:
Day 31
6/19/26
Rough end to the week. First of all I shouldn't have even traded today. I definitely wanted to make some sort of money and pass my evaluation. I copy traded my eval with my fundeds and took straight Ls. Not A+ trades, PA was shitty and I was forcing something wasn't there. Scaling in and out of my position because I wasn't confident. I tried not to overtrade and start spiraling. I ended up catching one trade to bring me out of drawdown and get the winning day. At that point I was not going to force anything and realized I shouldn't be on here so I did locked out. Unfortunately the eval didn't make it. Definitely a bit mentally slower from this winning streak and payout. This is conducive to my past behavior when I go on winning streaks. At least today I contained it and it'll give me time to reflect this weekend however, I cannot reinforce this negative identity in myself that I act this way. Still finishing this week green and pretty solid execution except today. (edited)
Friday, June 19, 2026 at 9:23 AM
